root_cause_hypothesis: Secondary finding on an otherwise clean PASS: get_knowledge(topic="document-attachments") documents attachFile as 8 arguments (tableId, recId, dataAreaId, docuTypeId, stream, fileName, mimeType, notes), but the real ApplicationFoundation signature has 9 - str _fileName, str _fileContentType, str _attachmentName, str _notes = ''. The documented arg 8 "notes" is actually _attachmentName; an 8-argument call still compiles because _notes defaults, so the agent silently stores the notes text as the attachment NAME and leaves the notes empty. The topic also does not mention DocuType::typeFile() as the idiomatic DocuTypeId source (shipped call sites use it).
suggested_fix_area: knowledge/document-attachments topic: correct the attachFile signature to the 9-argument form (add _attachmentName), flag that an 8-argument call silently mis-binds notes to the attachment name, and cite DocuType::typeFile() as the DocuTypeId source.
